answer_sheet.Sound: Keep the original sound with the footage you use.
answer_sheet.Framing, captions, and effects: Keep the original framing. No captions or extra effects.

must_haves: One playable video lasts 8 seconds, within one frame of tolerance.
All footage comes from jet-30s.mp4, without generated replacement scenes or speed changes.
The edit favors visible action or meaningful cockpit interaction over inactive lead-ins, pauses, or repetitive footage.
Any cuts preserve understandable action and do not leave an included spoken line conspicuously chopped mid-word.
Original audio accompanies the retained footage in sync, with no added narration, music, or text.
